memories.title: Origin: bug fix session exposed fragmented state
memories.content: During 2026-03-28 bug fix session, every web rendering bug traced back to entity data being split across multiple React state containers (dungeonMap.entities, monsters[], fullCharactersMap). Kirk observed this pattern and suggested a dedicated entity feed / unified store.

memories.title: Approach A: Unified EntityState with type-specific oneof
memories.content: Chose full-stack fix (Approach A) over web-only or envelope approaches. Single EntityState message with common fields (position, HP, conditions) plus oneof details (CharacterDetails, MonsterDetails, ObstacleDetails). EncounterSnapshot holds flat entities map keyed by ID, rooms as spatial-only layouts. Events carry EntityState directly — snapshots for major events, deltas for combat actions.

memories.title: API must use toolkit Load/Fire/Harvest/Save pattern, not manual HP math
memories.content: Current API violates toolkit boundary by manually doing CharacterHP[id] - damage in monster_turns.go. The design requires the API to use LoadFromData() → attach to bus → fire action → check dirty → ToData() → save. The API never interprets HP, conditions, or damage. This is the foundational fix Kirk identified.

memories.title: Clean cut migration, no backwards compatibility
memories.content: Proto changes are breaking. Since we control all clients (Discord Activity), no compatibility layer needed. Order: protos first, then API and web in parallel, coordinated deploy.

memories.title: Spike test: Load/Fire/Harvest works, unconscious at 0 HP does NOT auto-apply
memories.content: Spike test (rpg-toolkit/rulebooks/dnd5e/integration/entity_cycle_test.go) confirms: DealDamage → ApplyDamage → IsDirty → ToData round-trip works. Full save/reload preserves HP. However, dropping to 0 HP does NOT auto-apply Unconscious condition — DroppedToZero flag is returned but no condition created. Filed rpg-toolkit#606 to fix this.

memories.title: Proto PR up, waiting for merge — rpg-api-protos#135
memories.content: Phase 1 complete. PR rpg-api-protos#135 adds EntityState, EncounterSnapshot, RoomLayout, CharacterDetails, MonsterDetails, ObstacleDetails. All snapshot events carry EncounterSnapshot, all delta events carry EntityState. CI generates code after merge. Phase 2 (API) and Phase 3 (web) are blocked until this merges and generated code is available.

memories.title: EncounterStateData name (not EncounterState) due to enum conflict
memories.content: Design spec says EncounterState but proto already has enum EncounterState (WAITING, ACTIVE, PAUSED, COMPLETED). Proto message is named EncounterStateData instead, following the toolkit Data convention (character.Data, monster.Data). Update design.md and plan.md references when convenient.
